interpretation: All observations use the same frozen limits. The earlier Bun archive-stock RSS loss is retained in full.
The unchanged source already passed before startup serialization. That fix is not evidence of a memory optimization.

Each workload starts in a fresh child; catalog RSS cannot carry into archive-stock. The process high-water mark includes the assertion instrument, including complete rows, search membership and preview copies.
These repeated observations do not isolate an allocator, garbage-collector or workload-retention cause. Peak heap and cause remain unmeasured; a passing repeat is not a general memory guarantee.
